en.intro: Subtitles that open as a wall of nonsense are almost always read with the wrong encoding. Drop the file in, and it works out which encoding the file was really written in and puts the misread characters back.
en.feat: Uploaded files are re-decoded from the original bytes, so nothing is lost: if the file turns out to be GBK, it says so, and if your player is the one misreading it, saving a copy as "UTF-8 with BOM" usually settles it.
